summary: An AI-assisted prediction-market prototype for discovering markets, reading streamed context, and tracking simulated positions.

challenge.title: Making unfamiliar prediction markets easier to explore and understand.
challenge.description: The challenge was to connect market discovery, detail views, AI context, and portfolio feedback in one coherent demo while keeping external API failures and simulation boundaries clear.

solution.title: Combining market discovery with streamed AI context and simulated placements.
solution.description: I built a Next.js application with searchable and trending markets, detail pages, and a demo portfolio. Separate services handle Gamma-shaped market data, OpenRouter streaming, short-lived recommendation caching, and simulated placements. Local market fixtures provide a fallback, while demo authentication and in-memory positions keep the prototype's scope explicit.
